source: User-confirmed repaired-schematic coordinates supplied in this task, 2026-10-18
bounds_are: Approximate principal camera regions, inclusive. Not ownership of every wire or all connected control circuitry.

exact_landmarks.register_input_repeaters: Same x/y as register storage; z in {40,46}. Delay 2 after repair; distinct from storage repeaters at z {39,47}, delay 1.

validation: All 254 supplied PC/ALU/register landmark coordinates match repeater blocks in the parsed schematic.
rom_cells: Exact manifest formula, transformed into local coordinates: x=30-2*(address%16), y=14-4*(address//16), z=34+2*bit.
encoding_view: Operation-label sign neighborhood; not a certified decoder module boundary.
storage_encoding: At the storage probes: powered=false is logical 1, powered=true is logical 0. Both banks store mirrored values.
pc_reset: Synchronous PC-only reset tested: assert lever, allow settling, then clock. Not a full CPU reset; does not clear register banks.
